datePolicy: Every cited source is explicitly dated 2026-11-06 Asia/Singapore in original sources.md; observations approximately 2026-11-05 23:10–23:32 UTC, November 5 in Chicago. The research-session date is not a November 6 Chicago checkout observation. Authoring date does not refresh sources. March 2027 price/stock unknown; no external lookup performed.
uncertainties: Desk research only, not hands-on or medical evidence. Neither pick proves very quiet sleep plus 4.8 ACH for this bedroom; symptom relief is not guaranteed.
Assumes closed 300 sq ft bedroom, 8 ft ceiling, approximate mixing. Open doors and higher ceilings change sizing. Equivalent ACH is not fresh-air ventilation.
Core 600S-P meets only before-tax USD 300 cap at USD 299.99. March 2027 stock, prices, tax/delivery total and usable return terms remain unknown.
Current Core shipped revisions unresolved; Levoit HEPA wording is Sleep-specific, not unrestricted all-speed H13. Vital 50/51 W and Core 600S 49/66 W page/manual conflicts retained.

HouseFresh PM1 estimates differ from AHAM CADR. Older samples, UK Mighty sample, revision/voltage/acoustics and internal Vital sound discrepancy limit transfer. Manufacturer minimum noise is not trial-speed noise.

Coway current AHAM registry status not confirmed, not proof of non-certification. Winix 5520 has manufacturer AHAM claim, not independent directory confirmation. Coway/Winix CADR units not printed in source tables; ionization-off CADRs unknown.
200M Manual 2 and Winix 5520 Medium sound/CADR/power unknown. Switch off ionizer/PlasmaWave and recheck mode/restart; do not assume unchanged rated performance.

Filter lives are conditional schedules. Core 400S guidance assumes 12 hours/day; Coway 8 hours/day maximum speed; continuous use may need earlier replacement. Included first filter not extra day-one spending. Filter budgets exclude tax/shipping.
Constant-draw electricity calculations are illustrations, not measured annual bills. USD 0.20/kWh is not a researched Chicago tariff. Ratings are not sleep-speed consumption.

Honeywell exclusions are retailer-specific; no verified Winix 5510 direct offer does not prove universal discontinuation. No purchase, account creation, seller contact, publication, source-run changes or website-repository changes. Parent owns inventory/build/full checks.
editingContract: English-only Markdown, schema-v2 shared data and assigned author note only. All six options, exact-model CADRs, sleep-setting evidence gaps, filter/energy costs and non-medical/ozone limits preserved. Four supported FAQs. No ratings, stars, Review or AggregateRating markup, unhosted-download promises or source refresh. Bilingual multiplicity/table parity not applicable because no Chinese locale is assigned.
